title: HungerStation orders
subtitle: Every order HungerStation sent us directly: what became of it on our side, and the failures to retry.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the HungerStation orders grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

filters.qPlaceholder: HungerStation order id, order code or our document number
filters.windowInvalid: Enter a valid start and end date.
filters.windowReversed: The end date is before the start date.
filters.windowTooLong_one: The window is at most {{max}} day. Narrow the dates to search.
filters.windowTooLong_other: The window is at most {{max}} days. Narrow the dates to search.
filters.windowOutOfBounds: Dates run from {{earliest}} to {{latest}} (tomorrow). Move the window inside them.

unmatched.title: The vendor id belongs to no onboarded store
unmatched.hint: Onboard the store with this vendor id, or revive it if it was removed. A retry cannot help until then.

other.title: This order needs a person
other.hint: The server flagged this order for a person to look at.

runs.none: Intake failed before a run was written

results.failedTitle: The orders could not be loaded

detail.failed: The order could not be loaded
detail.noDeliveries: No delivery is recorded for this order.

raw.eyebrow: Raw delivery, as HungerStation sent it
raw.failed: The raw body could not be loaded
raw.readOnly: Read only. Shown as received; the layout below only adds line breaks and indents.
raw.notJson: The body is not valid JSON, so it is shown exactly as received.
raw.copyFailed: The raw body could not be copied

retry.title: Retry this order
retry.note: Retrying re-runs order <order>{{order}}</order>'s latest run only. Its row reads Pending until the worker has run it.
retry.doneDetail: Order {{order}} is back on the queue. Its row reads Pending until the worker runs it.
retry.notRequeuedDetail: Order {{order}} was not re-queued. Its row shows where it stands.
retry.notFailed: This order is no longer failed — it is done, waiting, cancelled or already has its document. Its row has been refreshed.
retry.noSuchOrder: There is no such HungerStation order.
